assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage controls, fire access, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is a formal AI design submission with explicit provisional-geometry limits; it is not an approved regulatory plan or construction document.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional geometry derived from public text, approximate areas, and location clues.
assumptions.impact: All spatial conclusions, areas, ratios, images, PDFs, HTML, and metrics must be recalculated when official polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, setbacks, municipal capacity, transport demand, and energy capacity are not invented; they remain unknown until official controls and professional surveys are supplied.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints and renewal actions express conceptual spatial intent only.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, testbeds, annual events, developer community operations, and public-space services are reference schemes for professional and operating teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: No activity, investment, supplier, funding, government arrangement, or implementation commitment is asserted.

assumptions.statement: The six global ecosystem cases are based on public webpages and are used to extract transferable organizational patterns, not to assert local performance, funding, or implementation facts.
assumptions.impact: Case comparisons support concept formation only and do not replace local data or formal standards.
